schema:
tenant=spider_customers_and_orders
tables:
  - Addresses
      address_id: int — address id
      address_details: str — address details

      order_id: int — order id
      customer_id: int — customer id
      order_date: str — order date
      order_status_code: str — order status code values: 'Completed', 'Part'
  - Customers
      customer_id: int — customer id
      address_id: int — address id
      payment_method_code: str — payment method code values: 'Credit Card', 'Direct Debit'
      customer_number: str — customer number
      customer_name: str — customer name
      customer_address: str — customer address
      customer_phone: str — customer phone
      customer_email: str — customer email
  - Order_Items
      order_item_id: int — order item id
      order_id: int — order id
      product_id: int — product id
      order_quantity: str — order quantity values: '1', '2', '4', '5', '7', '8', '9'
  - Products
      product_id: int — product id
      product_type_code: str — product type code values: 'Clothes', 'Hardware'
      product_name: str — product name
      product_price: float — product price
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Customer_Orders.customer_id → Customers.customer_id
  - Order_Items.product_id → Products.product_id
  - Order_Items.order_id → Customer_Orders.order_id
